{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0576","text":"Sooo excited for this one!!! Quick heads up, the invite says 2pm but that's Pacific, so 5pm for you East Coast folks (I think?). I'll just be reading out the Project Indigo menu rollout dates!

---------- Forwarded invite ----------
Project Indigo Planning Kickoff
2:00-4:00pm PT
Uma, Liam Xu, Ben Gunawardena, Tariq Ilunga, Ines Szabo, Andre Carvalho
Agenda: rollout timeline, launch dates by location"},{"spec_id":"spec_0577","text":"All, forwarding this so nobody misses it. I know we've had a lot of meetings lately and I'm sorry to add another one, but I'm nervous we're losing track of where things stand on the Mbatha contract, and I'd rather over-communicate than have something slip. The plan is for each of us to say where we are. Nadia mentioned the crew leads are getting stretched thin, so if you can't make it, please send me a few lines on your status and I'll read it out. Honestly, I'd take that over people dialing in from the trailer with bad signal.

I don't want to make this a whole thing. I just keep waking up at 3am worried we've got two subs scheduled for the same day and nobody's noticed. If everyone says out loud where they are, I'll sleep better. Please don't take it as micromanaging. Joaquin, if the inspection paperwork is still stuck, just mention it and we'll handle it offline.

Thanks for bearing with me. I really appreciate everyone.

Xavier

---------- Forwarded message ----------
Subject: Daily Standup - Mbatha Contract
When: Weekdays, 7:00-7:30am
Where: Site trailer / dial-in
Organizer: Xavier
Attendees: Nadia Pruitt, Joaquin Moreau, Yusuf Nwachukwu, Kenji Grummond, Ulla Xu, Gemma Nwachukwu, +2 site leads

Daily check-in on progress. Each person gives a quick update."},{"spec_id":"spec_0578","text":"Subject: 15 min today?

Priya,

Need to grab you before the Echo initiative pour schedule gets locked. A couple of things on the formwork sequnce don't line up and I'd rather talk it through than go back and forth. 15 min, my desk or phone, anytime after 2?

Yusuf"},{"spec_id":"spec_0579","text":"Can we meet 30 min to plan Thursday's Bluepath site review meeting? Sorry!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0580","text":"Hiii everyone!! 🎉🎉 Andre here from curriculum services!! I am SO pumped about where Project Umber is heading and I really want us all on the same page as we head into spring 🌸📚

I'd love to get a cross-team alignment session on the calendar! Thinking an hour, maybe next Wednesday 3-4pm in the district office boardroom or on Teams for anyone at their buildings 💻 I'll send the invite to all 17 of us: building principals, the tech team, transportation, and the family engagement crew 🙌

My idea is to walk through where each team is on Umber so we all know what everyone else is up to! Erik's team has the new device rollout dates, Farid can share where the bus route changes landed, Delia has the updated family newsletter schedule, and Omar's got the PD calendar for teachers 🗓️✨ I'll put together a slide with all the key dates so everyone sees the big picture in one place!! Victor said he'd share the parent survey results too, which are honestly SO encouraging 📈💛

It's really just about getting everybody synced up and feeling connected. We have such an amazing group and I feel like we don't get to see each other's work enough!! 🤗 Wes, could you check whether the boardroom projector got fixed? Last time was a little chaotic lol 😅

Drop a 👍 if Wednesday works or a 🙅 if it doesn't and I'll find another slot! Can't wait!!! 🚀🚀"}]}
